remarks:
Welcome to 344 Parkhurst Blvd, a charming home on a picturesque, tree-lined street in Buffalo, featuring a welcoming exterior and a spacious backyard retreat. Fresh interior wall paint and an updated deck with new patio paint add a refreshed touch to this inviting property.

Inside, the sun-filled living room and dining area feature hardwood flooring, creating a comfortable space for everyday living and entertaining. The kitchen offers a sliding glass door that opens directly onto the expansive deck. Two bedrooms and a full bathroom complete the first floor. Upstairs, a versatile 28 x 13 space with a half bath offers flexibility for a bedroom, playroom, home office, or multipurpose retreat.

The outdoor space features a large, fully fenced backyard with mature trees, a relaxing hammock, and an additional patio area, providing multiple places to unwind or entertain. A single-car garage adds convenient parking and storage.

Situated in an established residential neighborhood, this home is within walking distance of Lincoln Park and Benjamin Franklin Middle School, with Deerhurst Park, Kenmore West Senior High School, and an Erie County Library branch nearby. Enjoy a blend of comfortable living, flexible space, and outdoor enjoyment in a convenient Buffalo location.
